title: Hear God in 5 Minutes: The S.O.A.K. Practice
hook: It’s easier than you think—try this 5‑minute listening practice.
script: Jesus said, My sheep hear my voice, John 10:27. Set a five‑minute timer. Scripture: read that verse once, slowly. Observe: notice one word that tugs at you—sheep, hear, follow. Ask: Jesus, what are You saying to me today about this? Be still two minutes. Jot the gentle thought that lands with peace. Keep: choose one tiny act in the next 24 hours that matches it. Safeguards keep you grounded: it won’t contradict Scripture; it will lean toward love, joy, and peace, like Galatians 5:22–23; and trusted believers can confirm it. Repeat tomorrow. Clarity grows with consistency. Save this and do it for seven days, then tell me what changed.

title: Stop Overthinking God’s Voice: Use the Peace Test
script: If you’re spiraling, pause. Breathe. Whisper, Speak, Lord, your servant is listening. John 10:27 says His sheep hear His voice. Here’s how to discern without drama. First, the tone: the Spirit convicts specifically and invites hope; accusation is vague and crushing. Second, the content: does it agree with Scripture and honor Jesus? Third, the fruit: after you sit with it, do you sense love, joy, or peace like Galatians 5:22–23, or only fear and frenzy? Now give God sixty quiet seconds. Notice the first steady, peace‑marked thought that aligns with the Word. Write it. Share it with a mature Christian. Take one small step today. Save to practice nightly.

title: When God Feels Silent: One Obedient Step
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: Sometimes you don’t need a louder voice, you need a smaller step. John 10:27 promises you can hear Jesus. Try this today. Read the verse once. Ask, Jesus, what one simple thing can I do in the next 24 hours to follow You? Wait two minutes. Usually a quiet nudge appears—send the text, forgive, take a walk without your phone, open your Bible before scrolling. Test it with Scripture, check for the Spirit’s fruit of peace, and run it by godly counsel if it’s big. Then do it. Obedience turns up the volume. Do this daily for a week. Watch clarity rise and anxiety drop. Save this to repeat.
